address: 168/4 Thepyothi Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani, Ubon Ratchathani, 34000, Thailand
bio: The menu boasts a tasty dried shredded pork and a range of sausages. A highlight is the Indochina pan-fried egg served with a side sandwich. The eggs are cooked sunny side up with margarine, then topped with sweet and salty Chinese sausage and peppery Vietnamese sausage slices....
